title: Transposed Poisson structures in graded and algebroid geometry
summary: We ask whether the transposed Leibniz rule $2z\cdot[x,y]=[z\cdot x,y]+[x,z\cdot y]$ survives the two passages that turn Poisson algebras into geometry, the shift of degree which produces Gerstenhaber algebras and the passage from algebras to algebroids. We introduce graded transposed Poisson algebras with a bracket of arbitrary degree and show that the parity of the degree decides which shape the answer takes.
